help_texts.code: Customer-facing code — letters, numbers, dashes and underscores; stored uppercase
help_texts.name: Optional internal label, never shown to customers
help_texts.type: Percent takes a percentage off the subtotal; fixed takes a flat amount off
help_texts.value_percent: Percentage off the order subtotal — 15.00 means 15%
help_texts.value_fixed: Flat amount off the order subtotal
help_texts.max_discount_amount: Optional ceiling for percent coupons — leave empty for no cap
help_texts.min_order_amount: Optional minimum merchandise subtotal required to use the coupon
help_texts.usage_limit: Total redemptions allowed across all customers — empty means unlimited
help_texts.per_user_limit: Redemptions allowed per customer — empty means unlimited
help_texts.starts_at: Coupon becomes usable from this moment (UTC)
help_texts.ends_at: Coupon stops being usable after this moment (UTC)
help_texts.is_active: Inactive coupons fail evaluation immediately, even within their validity window
